en.body:
EDGE organized its first [Biennial Conference](/news/edge-biennial-conference-will-be-held-on-22-august-2023-in-bern-2/ "/news/edge-biennial-conference-will-be-held-on-22-august-2023-in-bern-2/") on 22 August 2023 in Bern: a public conference aiming at bridging academia, policy and industry to facilitate the development of networks outside academia and to enable EDGE findings to be communicated. A total of about 110 people attended and the room was full!

Download the programme [here](/files/images/content/Final%20Agenda_EDGE%20biennial%20conference_22%20August%202023_room%20number.pdf)
